'''Kylo Ren's command shuttle''' was an [[Upsilon-class command shuttle|''Upsilon''-class command shuttle]] utilized by [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]], who was a leader of the [[Knights of Ren]] and a [[warlord]] of the [[First Order]] around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]]. His ship led a group of [[AAL-1971/9.1 Troop Transport|Atmospheric Assault Landers]] to the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Finalizer]]''.

==Description==
Kylo Ren's command shuttle featured two shield generators, instead of one as was typical on most starships. This simplified and strengthened shield distribution. The shuttle also featured an experimental magnetic field projection system, particularly effective against plasma rounds. This forced incoming projectiles off course.<ref name="Cross" />

==History==
[[File:Rey_captured.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Finn]] watches as Ren's command shuttle leaves Takodana with Rey on board.]]
[[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren's]] command shuttle<ref name="DB" /> was present during the [[Attack on Tuanul|subjugation of Tuanul]], [[Jakku]] and the [[Battle of Takodana]] landing at the remains of [[Takodana Castle]]. The ship delivered [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] to [[Starkiller Base]] where she was to be interrogated by Ren himself.<ref name="Episode VII" />

After Ren usurped the title of Supreme Leader by killing [[Snoke]], he and General [[Armitage Hux]] commanded the First Order forces during the [[Battle of Crait]] from the shuttle's bridge. After the sudden appearance of Luke Skywalker, Ren ordered the shuttle's pilot, [[Jober Tavson]], to land the craft on the salty plains so he could confront his former Jedi Master, hurling General Hux against a control console when the man protested.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The command shuttle was first seen in the second teaser for [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars:'' Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. The craft was one of the exclusive blueprints in ''[[Star Wars: Ships of the Galaxy]]'', released on [[Force Friday]] on [[September 4]], [[2015]].

Kylo Ren's command shuttle was introduced as a playable ship of the same name in the 2015 mobile game ''Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes'' in 2017, which features characters and ships from both the canon and Legends continuities.<ref name="GoH">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]''</ref>
